patterns.note: Content is primarily presented in a single-column, center-aligned layout for narrative text, transitioning to horizontal carousels or grids for visual project showcases.

A distinct animated dot-matrix typeface is used for the hero heading, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body and titles, and a personal script font for the signature, establishing a varied yet sophisticated typographic hierarchy.
A high-contrast dark mode palette dominates, featuring a deep charcoal background with stark white text, accented by subtle hints of color within the embedded project visuals.

The main hero title 'Humanize Design' uses a subtle dot-matrix animation where individual elements appear or disappear to form the letters, adding an engaging, technical touch to the page's introduction.

Sections are clearly delineated by large, bold headings and smaller, uppercase sub-labels (e.g., '2019 - PRESENT', 'SPECIALTY', 'TESTIMONIALS'), guiding the user through the portfolio's narrative flow.

technique_notes: To achieve the dot-matrix text effect, render the text as a series of small, discrete graphical elements (dots or squares). Animate their individual opacity, scale, or position to create the effect of the characters forming or dissolving, possibly using SVG or a canvas element over regular text for accessibility.

For the high-contrast dark theme, use a rich, deep grey or off-black for the background rather than pure black, paired with a bright white or very light grey for primary text. Ensure sufficient vertical rhythm and line height for optimal readability.

Horizontal content carousels are created using a flexbox or grid container with `overflow-x: auto` and `white-space: nowrap` for the inner content. Each item within the carousel should have a defined width. Navigation arrows would use JavaScript to programmatically scroll the container left or right.
